newsitem.title: USA: TCI debt falls on NAIC downgrade talk-sources.
newsitem.headline: TCI debt falls on NAIC downgrade talk-sources.

text.p: TCI Communications Inc debt widened by 20 basis points on rumors that the National Association of Insurance Commissioners (NAIC) has downgraded the company's debt rating, according to market sources.
Market sources said the NAIC downgraded TCI's debt rating to three from two. The NAIC rates bonds on a scale of one to five, with one being the most credit-worthy, sources said.
Calls to the NAIC were not immediately returned. A TCI spokeswoman could not confirm the rumors.
The move comes one week after Standard & Poor's affirmed its BBB- corporate credit rating of TCI.
